skill.name: godot-gdscript-patterns
skill.description: Apply Godot 4 GDScript patterns for state machines, autoloads, resources, scene management, save systems, components, signals, and performance.
skill.summary: Use practical Godot 4 GDScript patterns to structure game systems and improve maintainability.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown resource paths or Godot APIs misclassified as shell, network, or reconnaissance behavior. The save-system example contains a hard-coded placeholder encryption key, which is not a live secret but is unsafe guidance if copied into production. No evidence of prompt injection or malicious intent was found in the reviewed files.

remediation.issue: Hard-coded encryption key in the save-system example
remediation.suggestion: Replace the placeholder with guidance to provide per-project or per-user keys securely, and state that sample keys must not be reused in production.

static_findings.snippet: # Create runtime copy to avoid modifying the resource

- **Pool frequently spawned objects** - Avoid GC hitches
- If detailed examples are required, open `resources/implementation-playbook.md`.

finding_verdicts.reason: ResourceLoader.load_threaded_request(path) is a Godot asynchronous resource loader for project assets, not an HTTP client. The surrounding scene manager example shows no URL or outbound network request.
The save-system example defines a literal placeholder encryption key in code. It is not a live credential, but copying this pattern into production would create weak secret management.
The line is a comment explaining why a Resource is duplicated at runtime. It does not inspect the host system, enumerate files, or collect environment details.
get_path() is used on a Godot Node to create a save identifier. This references an in-game scene node path, not the host filesystem or system reconnaissance.
The line is a performance-tip comment about avoiding allocations. It contains no reconnaissance behavior or system inspection.
The line is a best-practice bullet about using signals for decoupling. It does not request or perform system discovery.
The line recommends object pooling to reduce garbage collection hitches. It has no connection to host system reconnaissance.
The backticks format a Markdown file path in prose. There is no Ruby code, shell execution, or command invocation.
The backticks format a Markdown resource path in the Resources section. This is documentation text, not executable shell or Ruby syntax.

content.value_statement: Godot projects often grow brittle when signals, scenes, and save systems are improvised. This skill supplies reusable Godot 4 GDScript patterns for architecture, state, data, and performance.
actual_capabilities: Explains Godot node, scene, resource, and signal architecture for GDScript projects.
Provides state machine, autoload singleton, event bus, and resource data patterns.
Shows object pooling, component, scene manager, and save-system examples.
Recommends performance practices for cached nodes, static typing, and reduced allocations.
Guides clarification, implementation steps, and validation for Godot-specific tasks.
limitations: Does not run Godot, test projects, or verify engine-specific behavior.
Examples target Godot 4.x and may need adaptation for older versions.
Save-system examples require secure key management before production use.
Does not replace profiling, playtesting, or platform certification.

use_cases.title: Prototype Game Systems
use_cases.description: Plan state machines, scene transitions, pooling, and save flows before building a Godot prototype.

use_cases.title: Review GDScript Architecture
use_cases.description: Compare an existing Godot codebase against common patterns for signals, autoloads, resources, and components.

use_cases.title: Teach Godot Patterns
use_cases.description: Explain practical GDScript architecture patterns with focused examples and clear implementation tradeoffs.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Pattern
prompt_templates.prompt: I am building a Godot 4 game with [system]. Recommend the most relevant GDScript pattern from this skill and explain the core steps.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner selection for a new feature

prompt_templates.title: Implement a State Machine
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a Godot 4 GDScript state machine for [player or enemy behavior]. Include states, transitions, signals, and validation checks.

prompt_templates.title: Refactor Scene Communication
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Godot scene communication approach: [description]. Suggest improvements using signals, autoloads, resources, or components.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Production System
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a production plan for a Godot 4 [save, scene, pooling, or component] system. Include risks, testing steps, performance concerns, and secure defaults.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced system design with quality checks

output_examples.input: I need enemy AI states for patrol, chase, and attack.
output_examples.output: A state machine plan with separate state nodes, clear transition rules, signal usage, and validation steps for each behavior.

output_examples.input: My bullets cause frame drops when many enemies fire.
output_examples.output: An object pooling recommendation that covers pool size, spawn and return flow, cleanup, and profiling checks.

output_examples.input: I need save data for player position and collectibles.
output_examples.output: A save-system outline that separates saveable nodes, serialized data, load behavior, error handling, and secure key guidance.

best_practices: Use signals to decouple scenes and reduce direct node dependencies.
Cache node references and avoid allocations inside hot update paths.
Adapt examples to your project, then validate them inside Godot.
anti_patterns: Do not copy placeholder encryption keys into production save systems.
Do not use autoloads for every shared object or small dependency.
Do not rely on patterns without profiling, testing, and scene-specific validation.

faq.question: Which Godot version does this skill target?
faq.answer: It targets Godot 4.x and GDScript patterns used in modern Godot projects.

faq.question: Can it generate complete game code?
faq.answer: It can guide structure and examples, but complete projects need integration, assets, and testing.

faq.question: Does it support beginner users?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains core concepts before moving into architecture patterns and performance guidance.

faq.question: Can it review an existing GDScript design?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the design or code summary, and it can suggest relevant Godot patterns.

faq.question: Are the save-system examples production ready?
faq.answer: No. They show structure, but production saves need secure key handling and project-specific validation.

faq.question: Does it replace Godot documentation?
faq.answer: No. It complements documentation with implementation patterns and review prompts.
